functional.title: Recipe admission and provenance
functional.definition: Implement licensed input intake, image digest verification, fixed command catalog and content-addressed recipe manifests.

functional.title: Claims and comparison contract
functional.definition: Freeze evaluator, units, seed set, tolerance, baseline, hardware constraints and aggregation before procurement.

functional.title: Worker enrollment and purchase
functional.definition: Bind organization evidence, capacity offer, expiry and maximum spend. Reconcile paid reservations by merchant order identity.

functional.title: Leased isolated execution
functional.definition: Issue worker-scoped fenced leases, mount known inputs read-only, disable egress and pin the CPU execution profile.

functional.title: Artifact reception and verification
functional.definition: Collect outputs, runtime metadata, output cardinality, logs and hashes inside a bounded bundle. Recompute digests and seal the manifest.

functional.title: Deterministic comparison
functional.definition: Implement the pinned metric on worker outputs. Distinguish divergence from missing evidence, bad seed, metric mismatch or incompatible hardware.

functional.title: Report, settlement and repeatability
functional.definition: Ship run timeline, outcome explanation, independent-operator evidence, exact reproduction manifest and separate cost history.

nonfunctional.title: Replayable evidence
nonfunctional.definition: A reviewer can reproduce the outcome from the exact input revision, actor scope, persisted decision and redacted evidence reference after a process restart.

invariants.title: Recipe admission and provenance
invariants.definition: Only immutable reviewed recipes can be scheduled.

invariants.title: Claims and comparison contract
invariants.definition: A tolerance change creates a different claim ID and cannot rewrite an active run.

invariants.title: Worker enrollment and purchase
invariants.definition: A worker from the sponsor organization cannot be represented as independent.

invariants.title: Leased isolated execution
invariants.definition: Only the active lease may deliver the authoritative result.

invariants.title: Artifact reception and verification
invariants.definition: The evaluator sees sealed verified artifacts with a matching claim and attempt.

invariants.title: Deterministic comparison
invariants.definition: Only comparable complete outputs receive numerical reproduction or divergence verdicts.

invariants.title: Report, settlement and repeatability
invariants.definition: Payment eligibility follows contracted delivery criteria and cannot depend on matching the sponsor's preferred result.
